{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows and dtypes
print(df.head())
print('\nDtypes:')
print(df.dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nCount of -1 in customer_age:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue format
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):', df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for QA orders
print('\nQA orders (revenue == 999999.99):', (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nRefunded orders:', (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())"}
